mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, it is 67 degrees and clear at Fireman's Park under a Waning Gibbous moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Expect an overnight low of 56 degrees with rain predicted.

City engineering updates continue with the latest reports from AECOM, while the Wisconsin Department of Transportation is holding meetings regarding the US 18/151 corridor study to gather public feedback.

We have a busy schedule today including live music at Paddy Mac's, trivia at The Bogey Factory, yoga at Insight Wellness, and pizza at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, look forward to ART House 360 and trivia at Hop Haus.
Regarding local activity, on October 25, officers were dispatched to Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they arrested a 40-year-old man for O W I after he was found asleep in his vehicle.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM tonight.
